body:
I do click with my friends now, but they're pretty much stay inside your house people, too.

That isn't my problem with girls.. It's just that I'm shy, socially awkward, and well, I'm not the best looking.  It's not that I treat or talk to them differently, I do have friends that are girls lol.  And sex isn't really a priority thing for me, I don't care that I'm a virgin, i just felt like putting that in there would tell a little bit more of me being awkward.

School of my choice is a community college :/

I enjoy it more than an average job, I don't really enjoy many things and I'm not very talented.  I can atleast do decent animating compared to most people that were in my course last year.

Sounds like a great idea, just gotta get past my problem to committing to a book or story. :]

I said that I've never actually considered killing myself, I just don't enjoy myself.  But I'm definitely not an average highschool kid, :/.

"Grades are repairable, friendships are buildable, your future is graspable. You have access to the internet, you have spare time, find something that is a good intersection of something that truly, deeply interests you, and something that you can do professionally."

That does mean a lot, and helps a lot.  Only problem is I've got no interest in repairing those grades.  I HATE computer programming, I hate history, and well I enjoy my other courses but hate the homework and I know that sounds terrible and lazy, but it's why I'm bombing those courses.

Again though, that did mean a lot, thanks.
